name: Bottom Feeder
description:
All caught trash and treasure is replaced by scrap.

  • Common: Leather, Ink Sacs, Glow Ink Sacs, String, Lily Pads, Blaze Rods: 4-16 per catch
  • Uncommon: "Geode," "Dye Trader Bag," "Pottery Bag"
  • Rare: Crusted Gem, Crusted Rune, "Home Videos"
  • Very Rare: 1-2 Netherite Scrap
